faq.question: What is the premise of Blade Runner 2099?
faq.answer: Blade Runner 2099 is set decades after the original films, in a world where replicants have won a full-scale uprising and humans are now second-class citizens. The series follows this inverted dystopia, exploring themes of identity, revenge, and survival as former oppressors become the oppressed.

faq.question: Who is the showrunner and which actors are starring in the series?
faq.answer: The series is showrun by Silka Luisa, who aims to stay true to the Blade Runner franchise's noir roots. Michelle Yeoh stars in a leading role. The show will consist of ten episodes on Prime Video.

faq.question: How does Blade Runner 2099 connect to the original Blade Runner films?
faq.answer: The series shares the same universe as the original films and takes place decades after their events. It dramatically reverses the power dynamics: replicants are now in control, and humans are the hunted minority, offering a fresh perspective on the franchise's core themes.

faq.question: When is Blade Runner 2099 coming out and where can I watch it?
faq.answer: The first teaser debuted at San Diego Comic-Con 2026, but an exact premiere date has not yet been announced. The series will be released exclusively on Prime Video as a ten-episode season.

faq.question: What are the central themes of Blade Runner 2099?
faq.answer: The series explores artificial consciousness, systemic prejudice, morality, and the definition of humanity. It examines what happens when the oppressed become the oppressors, echoing real-world debates about AI rights and sentience, while staying grounded in the franchise's noir style.
